_readme: Hand-curated image overrides keyed by GoCars type_id. An entry here WINS over
Only add an entry after looking at the photo and confirming it shows a vehicle
that actually belongs to that type. The previous hardcoded catalogue had 22
unique images across 34 vehicles -- Jeeps rendered a Skoda, bicycles rendered a
Fiat Panda. A correct GoCars studio render always beats a nicer photo of the
wrong car, so leaving a type absent is the safe default.
Paths are public/ relative and must start with a slash.
Populated in full during Phase 3; the three below are verified 1:1 matches.
